$comment: Declared must-agree copies, checked byte-for-byte by scripts/check-parity.mjs (npm run check:parity; CI runs it). Each entry keeps a deliberately-parallel pair honest: DRY stays secondary, agreement becomes loud. Add a copy that must agree with existing code here (or share/derive/drift-test it) in the same commit that creates it; retire an entry only together with the shared owner or behavioral test that replaces it. Spec: docs/specs/duplication-drift-guards.spec.md.

sets.name: surface-id-generator
sets.why: UUIDv7 ids from all three surfaces land in the same model files and must sort consistently; the packages deliberately do not import each other

sets.name: sqlglot-bridge
sets.why: the same SQL must parse the same way whichever connector asks; each connector owns its subprocess I/O by design, so the bridge is deliberately parallel (headers differ, everything else may not)

sets.name: pascal-case-avro
sets.why: record names must align between core's Avro mapper and the formats exporter or exported schemas reference names the mapping never produced

sets.name: pascal-case-openapi
sets.why: schema names must align between core's OpenAPI mapper and the formats exporter, same shape as the Avro pair

sets.name: sql-quote-ident
sets.why: CREATE TABLE and its own population INSERTs must quote identifiers identically or the INSERTs target tables the DDL never created

sets.name: import-alternatives-diff-summary
sets.why: the alternative-framing diff summary is one sentence shape shown on both surfaces; the surrounding wrappers deliberately differ (plain text vs markdown), the summary may not

sets.name: node-engines
sets.why: package-lock.json embeds its own copy of the root package's engines field; 0f8bdaa raised package.json to >=26.0.0 and left the lock at >=20.0.0, and every gate stayed green (barwise-919)

sets.name: monorepo-version
sets.why: the project uses a single version across all packages, written in thirteen files and held together by the release procedure; exactly one pair was guarded before this entry, by the SERVER_VERSION drift test in packages/mcp/tests/server.test.ts
